name: 好酸球性筋膜炎

summary.text: A rare idiopathic inflammatory myopathy that is characterized by inflammation and thickening of the fascia, usually associated with peripheral eosinophilia. It presents during adulthood with symmetrical and painful swelling of mainly the extremities that progressively become indurated. Fatigue, disabling cutaneous fibrosis, myositis and arthritis may also be observed.

symptoms.text: symmetrical and painful swelling of mainly the extremities
